findings.claim: Read-only rested on Store, which writes on open.
Pending could not match claims list.

Opening a WAL-mode store with mode=ro creates -shm and -wal files beside it and leaves them after close, so the plan's read mechanism breaks its own acceptance and eval r2 (no file under .kmctl/ or .kmaudit/ appears). The legacy store and every Store-made store are WAL. The plan must pick a mechanism that leaves no sidecars (for example immutable=1, which skips locking and ignores a live -wal, so it can miss rows a running writer has not checkpointed) or narrow r2 to allow sidecars, and say which.
